fieldValues.title: Key Invariants's 20 subsections were already vestigial before srs#690 started
fieldValues.summary: srs#690 describes dissolving Key Invariants by moving its (it says 19, actually 20) subsections under the concepts they constrain. All 20 turned out to already be empty: content field blank, zero contains children. The actual invariant text they used to hold had already migrated to flat records under records/invariants/, each carrying its own contains parent onto a concept, and RFC-042 [R9]'s generator (scripts/render-invariants.mjs) already produces the '#### Key Invariants' generated index by walking those records directly, grouped by that parent, independent of these subsections entirely. Re-parenting the 20 empty shells therefore changed no rendered content by itself but does complete the literal instruction and gets Key Invariants down to zero contains children.
evidence: scripts/render-invariants.mjs's own inline comment already documents RFC-042 [R9]: an invariant's group is its contains parent, not applies_to or Key Invariants membership
Census of all 20 subsections under Key Invariants (df42f888-4d95-5a51-963e-60d10c36533c) before this unit: fieldValues.content is empty and zero contains children, for every one
grep for each of the 20 subsections' exact titles against docs/spec/srs-spec.md before this unit's render found none of them rendered as headings
